text: Easy: What does CSS stand for?
explanation: Cascading Style Sheets or CSS allows you to specify styles for the visual elements of the website.

text: Easy: In the CSS rule `H1 { color : green }`, what is `H1` referred to as?
explanation: The selector is the HTML element on which you want to apply the style. Here H1 is the selector.

text: Medium: Which tab in the CSS Stylesheets dialog box allows you to change the 'Case' of text (e.g., to Uppercase)?
explanation: In the Text tab... Choose 'Uppercase' from the Case menu.

text: Hard: To enable CSS by default in KompoZer, which menu path must be followed?
explanation: To make sure that KompoZer uses CSS by default, click Edit -> Preferences. This will open Options dialog box.

text: Easy: Which button on the Composition Toolbar is used to open the CSS Stylesheets dialog box?
explanation: In the composition toolbar, select the Cascade button. This will open the CSS Stylesheets dialog box.

text: Medium: What are the two main parts of a CSS rule?
explanation: A CSS rule has two main parts: a selector, and one or more declarations.

text: Hard: In the CSS 'Background' tab, which option allows you to make an element transparent?
explanation: The 'Opacity' slider is visible in the Background tab shown in Figure 2.6 and 2.8.

text: Easy: JavaScript is primarily used for which purpose in HTML forms?
explanation: It is used to validate the data entered in the HTML forms on the client side before sending it to the server.

text: Medium: Which HTML tag is used to embed JavaScript code into a web page?
explanation: The <script> tag tells the browser to interpret all the text between the <script> tag as a script.

text: Hard: When attaching a validation script to a form, which event attribute is typically used in the 'Advanced Property Editor'?
explanation: In the Attribute option select 'onsubmit' and in the Value write 'return validateForm()'.

text: Easy: Is JavaScript case-sensitive?
explanation: Remember, JavaScript is a case sensitive language.

text: Medium: Which tab in the CSS Stylesheets dialog allows you to set a 'dotted' line around an element?
explanation: To set the border, select the Border tab... You can also specify the width and the color of the border as per your choice (Example shows 'dotted' style).

text: Hard: What does the statement `return false;` do in a form validation script?
choices: It stops the form from being submitted.
explanation: In the validation logic: `alert(...); return false;`. If validation fails, returning false prevents the form submission (implied by standard JS validation logic shown).

text: Easy: Which function is used in JavaScript to display a pop-up message box?
explanation: The script example shows: `alert('Please enter the Name');`.

text: Medium: What is the main advantage of using CSS mentioned in the text?
explanation: CSS allows... Avoid duplication in coding... Use the same content with different styles... Easy maintenance.

text: Hard: Where should the `<script>` tag ideally be placed in an HTML document?
explanation: JavaScript can be placed inside the <body> or <head> section of an HTML page. But generally it is preferred that the code be placed in the <head> tag.

text: Easy: In CSS syntax, the Property and Value are separated by which symbol?
explanation: The general syntax of CSS is defined as: `selector {property : value}`.

text: Medium: Which tab in the CSS Stylesheets dialog displays the actual CSS code generated?
explanation: Click on the General tab. This will show the CSS code which is generated as shown in figure 2.10.

text: Hard: In the JavaScript example `document.write('HELLO STUDENTS')`, what does `document` refer to?
explanation: Here write is a method which is a part of the document object. The string to be displayed is passed as variable to the method `document.write()`.

text: Easy: What symbol marks the start and end of a JavaScript block?
explanation: JavaScript statements can be grouped together in a block. A block starts and ends with the curly bracket { }.

text: Medium: To apply a style to all `h1` elements, which option do you select in the CSS dialog?
choices: style applied to all elements of class
style applied to all elements of type
style applied to an element with ID
explanation: Click on the first radio button 'style applied to all elements of type'. In the drop down menu choose an element... h1.

text: Hard: What is a disadvantage of CSS mentioned in the text?
choices: CSS compatibility varies with different browsers.
explanation: Disadvantages of CSS: The CSS compatibility varies with different browsers.

text: Easy: Which tab would you use to change the font family of text in CSS?
explanation: Select h1... Click the Text tab... show various style options like Font family, Font size....

text: Medium: What does the `var` keyword do in JavaScript?
explanation: The script uses `var x = ...` to declare a variable x to hold the field value.

text: Hard: In the CSS 'Text' tab, what does the 'Alignment' option control?
explanation: The Text tab image shows an 'Alignment' dropdown with the value 'Center' selected, referring to text alignment.

text: Easy: What is used to separate multiple statements in JavaScript?
explanation: The semicolon is used as a mark of separation rather than termination. Thus, if you place each statement on a new line then you need not put a semicolon.

text: Medium: If you want to put an image in the background of a webpage using CSS, which tab do you go to?
explanation: Note: If you want to keep an image in the background then in the Image option, click on 'Choose file' (inside the Background tab).

text: Hard: Which button allows you to add JavaScript events to a form element in KompoZer?
explanation: Click on Advanced Edit button. This will open Advanced Property Editor dialog box... Select the JavaScript Events tab.

text: Easy: What does `document.write()` do?
choices: Writes text to the web page
explanation: The string to be displayed is passed as variable to the method `document.write()`.

text: Medium: What type of bracket is used to enclose CSS declarations?
explanation: Figure 2.1 shows the syntax of CSS: `H1 { color : green }`. Curly braces are used.
